channel.title: les Archives
channel.description: Sparkle update feed for les Archives

item.title: les Archives 1.2.0
item.description: Simple caption, one unified Feed Preview, draft swapping on week/pipeline/phone, carousels in the pipeline, and a cleaner Pinterest setup.

item.title: les Archives 1.1.9
item.description: A big pass on Carousel Studio and scheduling. Moving photos, text, and shapes on the canvas is smooth now, and grabbing text moves it instead of rotating. The Open panel shows each draft's first slide. Scheduling a carousel gives you a clear Write with AI caption button, and any image without a caption gets a Generate button. Sidebar Settings links jump to their section, Archive bulk edit covers every per-photo field, Clear All actually clears Instagram drafts, the draft scheduler is Instagram only, and Pinterest's Lineup now shows each slot's time, blocks slots that already passed, and follows your real posting schedule.

item.title: les Archives 1.1.8
item.description: Catalog and Archive top-bar menu labels (View, New Job, Sort, All) render light again on the dark bar.

item.title: les Archives 1.1.7
item.description: Restored the current Settings screen and the option to fill in a debrief yourself. Reworked carousel Border and Shadow controls with a live thickness slider, brand-color and custom swatches, and simple shadow presets. Borders now render on every edge. Fixed the EXPORT button so it shows its yellow again.

item.title: les Archives 1.1.6
item.description: Mostly polish this time. A warmer look across the app, a sidebar that opens on hover and stays where you leave it, and the status bar back to yellow. Invited team members now see only the work, never your plan, billing, or keys. Debriefs lock when you actually send them, and copying the link marks them sent.

item.title: les Archives 1.1.5
item.description: Signing in is now passwordless. We email you a six digit code, no password to remember. We also rebuilt the archive image viewer so zoom is faster and follows your cursor, and tidied up Settings along the way.

item.title: les Archives 1.1.4
item.description: Fixes the first-open security block by removing stray framework metadata from the package. Includes the rebuilt image zoom and recent reliability work.
